fn on_enter() {
    let active_mod = world.mod.current_id();

    if !world.entities.exists("core-game-mod") {
        world.entities.create("core-game-mod");
    }

    if world.runtime.dev_mode() && !world.entities.exists("core-game-dev-mode") {
        world.entities.create("core-game-dev-mode");
    }

    for mod_id in world.mod.loaded() {
        let marker = "mod:" + mod_id;

        if !world.entities.exists(marker) {
            world.entities.create(marker);
        }
    }

    world.dev.log("core-game mod runtime entered for mod=" + active_mod);
    world.dev.log("window backend=" + world.runtime.window_backend());
    world.dev.log("input backend=" + world.runtime.input_backend());
    world.dev.log("render backend=" + world.runtime.render_backend());
    world.dev.log("script backend=" + world.runtime.script_backend());
    world.dev.log("runtime capabilities=" + world.runtime.capabilities().len);
    world.dev.log("runtime plugins=" + world.runtime.plugins().len);
    world.dev.log("runtime services=" + world.runtime.services().len);
    world.dev.log("assets registered=" + world.assets.registered().len);
    world.dev.log("assets loaded=" + world.assets.loaded().len);
    world.dev.log("assets prepared=" + world.assets.prepared().len);
    world.dev.log("assets failed=" + world.assets.failed().len);
    world.dev.log("assets pending=" + world.assets.pending().len);
    world.dev.log("active mod assets=" + world.assets.by_mod(active_mod).len);

    for scene_id in world.mod.scenes() {
        world.dev.log("available scene for " + active_mod + ": " + scene_id);
    }
}

fn on_event(topic, payload) {
    if topic == "core-game.scene-ready" && payload.len > 0 {
        let scene_id = payload[0];
        let marker = "scene:" + scene_id;

        if !world.entities.exists(marker) {
            world.entities.create(marker);
        }

        world.dev.event("core-game.bootstrapped", scene_id);
        world.dev.log(
            "core-game dev shell bootstrapped for mod="
            + world.mod.current_id()
            + " scene="
            + scene_id
        );
    }

    if topic == "core-game.refresh-diagnostics" && payload.len > 0 {
        world.dev.refresh_diagnostics(payload[0]);
    }

    ()
}

SNAPSHOT_ID: 28aky

====================================================================================================
# Asteroids

Procedural, vector-first 2D playground mod for early Asteroids-style engine work.

Current scope:

- native `vector_2d` scene components
- WGPU stroke/fill rendering for simple vector shapes
- generated synthetic arcade SFX for shot, thrust, asteroid hits, wave progression, respawn protection, and game over cues
- lightweight runtime-owned `CircleCollider2D` overlap queries exposed through `world.physics`
- runtime vector mutation API exposed through `world.vector` for procedural shape updates
- no sprite assets
- no world wrap yet
- no full rigid-body or wrap-around gameplay physics yet

The first slice is intentionally small and exists to validate:

1. scene YAML -> vector hydration
2. runtime scene queueing
3. vector rendering in hosted mode
4. first playable ship / bullet / asteroid loop without bitmap assets
5. thin collision seam from scene components into Rhai through `world.physics.overlaps(...)`
6. first bounded two-wave arena flow before world-wrap work

Audio notes:

- all Asteroids SFX in this mod are procedural `generated-audio` metadata assets
- `thrust.yml` adds a soft low-frequency engine pulse intended for short boost/thrust accents
- `wave-start.yml` is a short upward cue for spawning/announcing the next wave
- `sector-clear.yml` is a brighter progression sting for clearing the current arena slice
- `respawn-shield.yml` is a soft protective cue for ship respawn / temporary invulnerability beats

Scene polish notes:

- the arena now uses a full black vector backdrop and a larger field/frame footprint tuned for full-window readability
- the HUD copy is tuned to feel a bit more arcade-like while keeping the same ids and script wiring
- the scene now runs a real second wave using additional off-screen-staged asteroid entities instead of stopping after the first clear
- asteroid silhouettes are generated procedurally in script and pushed into runtime via `world.vector.set_polygon(...)`

import "pkg:amigo.std/input" as input;

fn ship_name() { "playground-2d-asteroids-ship" }
fn shield_name() { "playground-2d-asteroids-ship-shield" }
fn thrust_name() { "playground-2d-asteroids-main-thruster" }
fn starfield_name() { "playground-2d-asteroids-speed-starfield" }
fn bullet_pool() { "player-bullets" }
fn asteroid_pool() { "asteroids" }

fn game_over_name() { "playground-2d-asteroids-game-over" }
fn hud_name() { "playground-2d-asteroids-hud" }
fn status_name() { "playground-2d-asteroids-center-status" }
fn ui_root(entity_name) { entity_name + ".root" }

fn shield_seconds() { 3.0 }
fn wave_clear_delay() { 1.2 }
fn status_flash_seconds() { 0.95 }
fn ship_spawn_rotation() { 1.5707963 }

fn mode(world_api) { world_api.state.get_string("game_mode") }
fn set_mode(world_api, value) { world_api.state.set_string("game_mode", value); }
fn score(world_api) { world_api.state.get_int("score") }
fn set_score(world_api, value) { world_api.state.set_int("score", value); }
fn lives(world_api) { world_api.state.get_int("lives") }
fn set_lives(world_api, value) { world_api.state.set_int("lives", value); }
fn wave(world_api) { world_api.state.get_int("wave") }
fn set_wave(world_api, value) { world_api.state.set_int("wave", value); }
fn low_mode(world_api) { world_api.session.get_bool("asteroids.low_mode") }
fn rng_seed(world_api) { world_api.state.get_int("rng_seed") }
fn set_rng_seed(world_api, value) { world_api.state.set_int("rng_seed", value); }

fn pad_two(value) {
    if value < 10 { return "0" + value; }
    return "" + value;
}

fn pad_score(value) {
    if value < 10 { return "00000" + value; }
    if value < 100 { return "0000" + value; }
    if value < 1000 { return "000" + value; }
    if value < 10000 { return "00" + value; }
    if value < 100000 { return "0" + value; }
    return "" + value;
}

fn clamp_int(value, min_value, max_value) {
    if value < min_value { return min_value; }
    if value > max_value { return max_value; }
    return value;
}

fn max_float(left, right) {
    if left > right { return left; }
    return right;
}

fn abs_float(value) {
    if value < 0.0 { return -value; }
    return value;
}

fn clamp_float(value, min_value, max_value) {
    if value < min_value { return min_value; }
    if value > max_value { return max_value; }
    return value;
}

fn thrust_hold(world_api) { world_api.state.get_float("ship.thrust_hold"); }
fn set_thrust_hold(world_api, value) { world_api.state.set_float("ship.thrust_hold", value); }

fn rand_next(world_api) {
    let next = (rng_seed(world_api) * 1664525 + 1013904223) % 4294967296;
    if next < 0 { next = -next; }
    set_rng_seed(world_api, next);
    return next;
}

fn rand01(world_api) {
    return rand_next(world_api) / 4294967296.0;
}

fn rand_range(world_api, min_value, max_value) {
    return min_value + (max_value - min_value) * rand01(world_api);
}

fn rand_int(world_api, min_value, max_value) {
    let span = max_value - min_value + 1;
    return min_value + (rand_next(world_api) % span);
}

fn sync_hud(world_api) {
    world_api.state.set_string("score_text", pad_score(score(world_api)));
    world_api.state.set_string("lives_text", "LIVES " + lives(world_api));
    world_api.state.set_string("wave_text", "WAVE " + pad_two(wave(world_api)));
    world_api.state.set_string("final_score_text", "SCORE " + pad_score(score(world_api)));
}

fn set_status(world_api, value) {
    world_api.state.set_bool("status_auto_clear", false);
    world_api.state.set_string("status_text", value);
    if value == "" {
        world_api.entities.hide(status_name());
        world_api.ui.hide(ui_root(status_name()));
    } else {
        world_api.entities.show(status_name());
        world_api.ui.show(ui_root(status_name()));
    }
}

fn set_timed_status(world_api, value, seconds) {
    set_status(world_api, value);
    world_api.state.set_bool("status_auto_clear", true);
    world_api.timers.start("status-clear", seconds);
}

fn update_status(world_api) {
    if world_api.state.get_bool("status_auto_clear") && world_api.timers.ready("status-clear") {
        world_api.state.set_bool("status_auto_clear", false);
        set_status(world_api, "");
    }
}

fn show_gameplay_ui(world_api) {
    world_api.entities.hide(game_over_name());
    world_api.ui.hide(ui_root(game_over_name()));
    world_api.entities.show(hud_name());
    world_api.ui.show(ui_root(hud_name()));
}

fn highscore(world_api, index) {
    return world_api.session.get_int("asteroids.highscore." + index);
}

fn set_highscore(world_api, index, value) {
    world_api.session.set_int("asteroids.highscore." + index, value);
}

fn maybe_insert_highscore(world_api, value) {
    if value > highscore(world_api, 1) {
        set_highscore(world_api, 5, highscore(world_api, 4));
        set_highscore(world_api, 4, highscore(world_api, 3));
        set_highscore(world_api, 3, highscore(world_api, 2));
        set_highscore(world_api, 2, highscore(world_api, 1));
        set_highscore(world_api, 1, value);
        return;
    }
    if value > highscore(world_api, 2) {
        set_highscore(world_api, 5, highscore(world_api, 4));
        set_highscore(world_api, 4, highscore(world_api, 3));
        set_highscore(world_api, 3, highscore(world_api, 2));
        set_highscore(world_api, 2, value);
        return;
    }
    if value > highscore(world_api, 3) {
        set_highscore(world_api, 5, highscore(world_api, 4));
        set_highscore(world_api, 4, highscore(world_api, 3));
        set_highscore(world_api, 3, value);
        return;
    }
    if value > highscore(world_api, 4) {
        set_highscore(world_api, 5, highscore(world_api, 4));
        set_highscore(world_api, 4, value);
        return;
    }
    if value > highscore(world_api, 5) {
        set_highscore(world_api, 5, value);
    }
}

fn reset_player(world_api) {
    world_api.entities.set_position_2d(ship_name(), 0.0, 0.0);
    world_api.entities.set_position_2d(shield_name(), 0.0, 0.0);
    world_api.entities.set_rotation_2d(ship_name(), ship_spawn_rotation());
    world_api.entities.set_rotation_2d(shield_name(), ship_spawn_rotation());
    world_api.motion.reset_freeflight(ship_name(), ship_spawn_rotation());
    world_api.motion.reset_freeflight(shield_name(), ship_spawn_rotation());
    world_api.motion.set_velocity(ship_name(), 0.0, 0.0);
    world_api.motion.set_velocity(shield_name(), 0.0, 0.0);
    world_api.particles.set_active(thrust_name(), false);
    world_api.particles.set_intensity(thrust_name(), 0.0);
    world_api.particles.set_active(starfield_name(), false);
    world_api.particles.set_intensity(starfield_name(), 0.0);
    set_thrust_hold(world_api, 0.0);
    world_api.entities.show(ship_name());
    world_api.entities.enable(ship_name());
    world_api.entities.set_collision_enabled(ship_name(), true);
    world_api.entities.show(shield_name());
    world_api.timers.start("ship-shield", shield_seconds());
}

fn start_new_game(world_api) {
    world_api.timers.reset_scene();
    set_score(world_api, 0);
    set_lives(world_api, 3);
    set_wave(world_api, 1);
    set_rng_seed(world_api, 1337);
    if low_mode(world_api) {
        set_rng_seed(world_api, 7331);
    }

    world_api.pools.release_all(bullet_pool());
    world_api.pools.release_all(asteroid_pool());
    show_gameplay_ui(world_api);
    sync_hud(world_api);
    set_timed_status(world_api, "READY", status_flash_seconds());
    reset_player(world_api);
    set_mode(world_api, "playing");
    start_wave(world_api, 1);
    world_api.audio.play("wave-start");
}

fn wave_asteroid_count(world_api, current_wave) {
    let base = 3 + current_wave;
    if low_mode(world_api) {
        base = base - 1;
    }
    return clamp_int(base, 3, 16);
}

fn wave_speed_min(world_api, current_wave) {
    let value = 55.0 + current_wave * 8.0;
    if low_mode(world_api) {
        return value * 0.72;
    }
    return value;
}

fn wave_speed_max(world_api, current_wave) {
    let value = 110.0 + current_wave * 12.0;
    if low_mode(world_api) {
        return value * 0.72;
    }
    return value;
}

fn wave_radius_min(current_wave) {
    return max_float(14.0, 34.0 - current_wave * 1.2);
}

fn wave_radius_max() { 44.0 }

fn score_for_radius(radius) {
    if radius >= 34.0 { return 20; }
    if radius >= 22.0 { return 50; }
    return 100;
}

fn smooth_step(value) {
    let t = clamp_float(value, 0.0, 1.0);
    return t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t);
}

fn ease_in_out_cubic(value) {
    let t = clamp_float(value, 0.0, 1.0);
    if t < 0.5 {
        return 4.0 * t * t * t;
    }
    let f = -2.0 * t + 2.0;
    return 1.0 - f * f * f / 2.0;
}

fn update_speed_starfield(world_api, thrust_axis, dt) {
    if thrust_axis <= 0.01 {
        set_thrust_hold(world_api, 0.0);
    } else {
        set_thrust_hold(world_api, clamp_float(thrust_hold(world_api) + dt, 0.0, 5.0));
    }

    let intensity = clamp_float((thrust_axis - 0.82) / 0.18, 0.0, 1.0);
    let ramp_raw = clamp_float((thrust_hold(world_api) - 0.72) / 1.35, 0.0, 1.0);
    let ramp = ease_in_out_cubic(ramp_raw);
    let streak = smooth_step(ramp * ramp);
    let motion = world_api.motion.state(ship_name());
    let speed_sq = motion.velocity_x * motion.velocity_x + motion.velocity_y * motion.velocity_y;

    if intensity <= 0.01 || ramp <= 0.01 || speed_sq < 115000.0 {
        world_api.particles.set_active(starfield_name(), false);
        world_api.particles.set_intensity(starfield_name(), 0.0);
        return;
    }

    let chaos_phase = (thrust_hold(world_api) * 21.0).to_int() % 4;
    let chaos = 0.0;
    if chaos_phase == 0 { chaos = 1.0 * ramp; }
    if chaos_phase == 1 { chaos = 0.45 * ramp; }

    world_api.particles.set_active(starfield_name(), true);
    world_api.particles.set_intensity(starfield_name(), intensity * ramp);
    world_api.particles.set_local_direction_degrees(starfield_name(), motion.angle_radians * 57.29578 + 180.0);
    world_api.particles.set_spawn_rate(starfield_name(), 32.0 + 112.0 * intensity * ramp + 42.0 * chaos);
    world_api.particles.set_lifetime(starfield_name(), 0.26 + 0.42 * ramp + 0.035 * chaos);
    world_api.particles.set_lifetime_jitter(starfield_name(), 0.06 + 0.045 * chaos);
    world_api.particles.set_speed(starfield_name(), 320.0 + 380.0 * intensity * ramp + 72.0 * chaos);
    world_api.particles.set_speed_jitter(starfield_name(), 44.0 + 92.0 * ramp + 32.0 * chaos);
    world_api.particles.set_spread_degrees(starfield_name(), 1.2 + 1.4 * chaos);
    world_api.particles.set_initial_size(starfield_name(), 0.16 + 0.18 * ramp);
    world_api.particles.set_final_size(starfield_name(), 0.55 + 1.35 * streak + 0.35 * chaos);
    world_api.particles.set_shape_line(starfield_name(), 3.0 + 20.0 * streak + 4.0 * chaos);
}

fn split_radius(radius) {
    if radius >= 34.0 { return radius * 0.58; }
    if radius >= 22.0 { return radius * 0.62; }
    return 0.0;
}

fn asteroid_size_for_radius(radius) {
    if radius >= 34.0 { return "large"; }
    if radius >= 22.0 { return "medium"; }
    return "small";
}

fn fragment_speed(world_api, parent_speed) {
    let min_speed = wave_speed_min(world_api, wave(world_api)) * 1.15;
    let speed = parent_speed * 1.18;
    return max_float(min_speed, speed);
}

fn random_spawn_position_away_from_center(world_api) {
    let origin = world_api.entities.position_2d(ship_name());
    let x = rand_range(world_api, -860.0, 860.0);
    let y = rand_range(world_api, -460.0, 460.0);

    if abs_float(x) < 220.0 && abs_float(y) < 180.0 {
        if abs_float(x) < abs_float(y) {
            if y >= 0.0 { y = 260.0; } else { y = -260.0; }
        } else {
            if x >= 0.0 { x = 300.0; } else { x = -300.0; }
        }
    }

    return #{ x: origin.x + x, y: origin.y + y };
}

fn direction_x(index) {
    if index == 0 { return 1.0; }
    if index == 1 { return 0.7071; }
    if index == 2 { return 0.0; }
    if index == 3 { return -0.7071; }
    if index == 4 { return -1.0; }
    if index == 5 { return -0.7071; }
    if index == 6 { return 0.0; }
    return 0.7071;
}

fn direction_y(index) {
    if index == 0 { return 0.0; }
    if index == 1 { return 0.7071; }
    if index == 2 { return 1.0; }
    if index == 3 { return 0.7071; }
    if index == 4 { return 0.0; }
    if index == 5 { return -0.7071; }
    if index == 6 { return -1.0; }
    return -0.7071;
}

fn configure_asteroid(world_api, asteroid, x, y, radius, vertices, speed, direction, seed) {
    world_api.entities.set_position_2d(asteroid, x, y);
    world_api.motion.set_velocity(
        asteroid,
        direction_x(direction) * speed,
        direction_y(direction) * speed,
    );
    world_api.vector.set_radial_jitter_polygon(asteroid, vertices, radius, 0.24, seed);
    world_api.physics.set_circle_radius(asteroid, radius);
    world_api.entities.set_property_string(asteroid, "asteroid_size", asteroid_size_for_radius(radius));
    world_api.entities.set_property_int(asteroid, "score_value", score_for_radius(radius));
    world_api.entities.set_property_float(asteroid, "radius", radius);
    world_api.entities.set_property_float(asteroid, "speed", speed);
}

fn start_wave(world_api, current_wave) {
    world_api.pools.release_all(asteroid_pool());
    let count = wave_asteroid_count(world_api, current_wave);
    let i = 0;

    while i < count {
        let asteroid = world_api.pools.acquire(asteroid_pool());
        if asteroid == "" { return; }

        let radius = rand_range(world_api, wave_radius_min(current_wave), wave_radius_max());
        let vertices = rand_int(world_api, 8, 14);
        let speed = rand_range(world_api, wave_speed_min(world_api, current_wave), wave_speed_max(world_api, current_wave));
        let direction = rand_int(world_api, 0, 7);
        let pos = random_spawn_position_away_from_center(world_api);
        let seed = rng_seed(world_api) + i;

        configure_asteroid(
            world_api,
            asteroid,
            pos.x,
            pos.y,
            radius,
            vertices,
            speed,
            direction,
            seed,
        );

        i = i + 1;
    }

    set_wave(world_api, current_wave);
    sync_hud(world_api);
    set_timed_status(world_api, "WAVE " + pad_two(current_wave), status_flash_seconds());
}

fn enter_wave_clear(world_api) {
    set_mode(world_api, "wave_clear");
    world_api.particles.set_active(thrust_name(), false);
    world_api.particles.set_intensity(thrust_name(), 0.0);
    world_api.particles.set_active(starfield_name(), false);
    world_api.particles.set_intensity(starfield_name(), 0.0);
    set_score(world_api, score(world_api) + wave(world_api) * 100);
    sync_hud(world_api);
    set_status(world_api, "WAVE CLEAR");
    world_api.timers.start("wave-clear", wave_clear_delay());
    world_api.audio.play("wave-start");
}

fn update_wave_clear(world_api) {
    if world_api.timers.ready("wave-clear") {
        let next_wave = wave(world_api) + 1;
        set_mode(world_api, "playing");
        start_wave(world_api, next_wave);
        world_api.audio.play("wave-start");
    }
}

fn enter_game_over(world_api) {
    set_mode(world_api, "game_over");
    world_api.pools.release_all(bullet_pool());
    world_api.pools.release_all(asteroid_pool());
    world_api.entities.hide(ship_name());
    world_api.entities.disable(ship_name());
    world_api.entities.set_collision_enabled(ship_name(), false);
    world_api.particles.set_active(thrust_name(), false);
    world_api.particles.set_intensity(thrust_name(), 0.0);
    world_api.particles.set_active(starfield_name(), false);
    world_api.particles.set_intensity(starfield_name(), 0.0);
    world_api.entities.hide(shield_name());
    maybe_insert_highscore(world_api, score(world_api));
    sync_hud(world_api);
    world_api.entities.hide(hud_name());
    world_api.ui.hide(ui_root(hud_name()));
    world_api.entities.show(game_over_name());
    world_api.ui.show(ui_root(game_over_name()));
    set_status(world_api, "");
    world_api.audio.play("game-over");
}

fn update_game_over(world_api) {}

fn update_shield(world_api) {
    if world_api.timers.active("ship-shield") {
        world_api.entities.show(shield_name());
    } else {
        world_api.entities.hide(shield_name());
    }
}

fn update_player_input(world_api, dt) {
    let thrust_axis = input::axis(world_api, "ship.thrust");
    update_speed_starfield(world_api, thrust_axis, dt);
}

fn update_playing(world_api, dt) {
    if input::pressed(world_api, "game.restart") {
        start_new_game(world_api);
        return;
    }

    update_player_input(world_api, dt);
    update_shield(world_api);
    update_status(world_api);
}

fn spawn_split_fragment(world_api, x, y, radius, speed, direction, seed) {
    let fragment = world_api.pools.acquire(asteroid_pool());
    if fragment == "" { return false; }

    let offset = radius * 0.55;
    configure_asteroid(
        world_api,
        fragment,
        x + direction_x(direction) * offset,
        y + direction_y(direction) * offset,
        radius,
        rand_int(world_api, 8, 12),
        speed,
        direction,
        seed,
    );
    return true;
}

fn split_asteroid(world_api, asteroid, radius, x, y) {
    let child_radius = split_radius(radius);
    if child_radius <= 0.0 { return 0; }

    let parent_speed = world_api.entities.property_float(asteroid, "speed");
    let speed = fragment_speed(world_api, parent_speed);
    let direction = rand_int(world_api, 0, 7);
    let opposite = (direction + 4) % 8;
    let seed = rng_seed(world_api);
    let spawned = 0;

    if spawn_split_fragment(world_api, x, y, child_radius, speed, direction, seed + 17) {
        spawned = spawned + 1;
    }
    if spawn_split_fragment(world_api, x, y, child_radius, speed, opposite, seed + 31) {
        spawned = spawned + 1;
    }

    return spawned;
}

fn handle_bullet_hit(world_api, bullet, asteroid) {
    let pos = world_api.entities.position_2d(asteroid);
    let radius = world_api.entities.property_float(asteroid, "radius");
    let score_value = world_api.entities.property_int(asteroid, "score_value");

    world_api.pools.release(bullet_pool(), bullet);
    set_score(world_api, score(world_api) + score_value);
    world_api.pools.release(asteroid_pool(), asteroid);
    split_asteroid(world_api, asteroid, radius, pos.x, pos.y);
    world_api.audio.play("asteroid-hit");
    sync_hud(world_api);

    if world_api.pools.active_count(asteroid_pool()) <= 0 {
        enter_wave_clear(world_api);
    }
}

fn handle_ship_hit(world_api) {
    if mode(world_api) != "playing" { return; }
    if world_api.timers.active("ship-shield") { return; }

    set_lives(world_api, lives(world_api) - 1);
    sync_hud(world_api);
    world_api.pools.release_all(bullet_pool());

    if lives(world_api) <= 0 {
        enter_game_over(world_api);
        return;
    }

    set_timed_status(world_api, "READY", status_flash_seconds());
    reset_player(world_api);
    world_api.audio.play("respawn-shield");
}

fn on_enter() {
    world.state.reset_scene();
    world.timers.reset_scene();

    let clips = [
        "shot",
        "asteroid-hit",
        "game-over",
        "wave-start",
        "respawn-shield",
    ];
    let clip_index = 0;
    while clip_index < clips.len() {
        world.audio.preload(clips[clip_index]);
        clip_index = clip_index + 1;
    }

    start_new_game(world);
}

fn on_event(topic, payload) {
    if topic == "asteroids.bullet_hit_asteroid" && payload.len() >= 2 {
        if mode(world) == "playing" {
            handle_bullet_hit(world, payload[0], payload[1]);
        }
        return;
    }

    if topic == "asteroids.ship_hit_asteroid" {
        handle_ship_hit(world);
        return;
    }
}

fn update(dt) {
    let current_mode = mode(world);

    if current_mode == "playing" {
        update_playing(world, dt);
        return;
    }

    if current_mode == "wave_clear" {
        update_wave_clear(world);
        return;
    }

    if current_mode == "game_over" {
        update_game_over(world);
        return;
    }

}

fn pad_score(value) {
    if value < 10 { return "00000" + value; }
    if value < 100 { return "0000" + value; }
    if value < 1000 { return "000" + value; }
    if value < 10000 { return "00" + value; }
    if value < 100000 { return "0" + value; }
    return "" + value;
}

fn highscore(world_api, index) {
    let value = world_api.session.get_int("asteroids.highscore." + index);
    if value > 0 { return value; }
    if index == 1 { return 10000; }
    if index == 2 { return 7500; }
    if index == 3 { return 5000; }
    if index == 4 { return 2500; }
    return 1000;
}

fn sync_highscores(world_api) {
    let text = "AAA " + pad_score(highscore(world_api, 1))
        + "\nBBB " + pad_score(highscore(world_api, 2))
        + "\nCCC " + pad_score(highscore(world_api, 3))
        + "\nDDD " + pad_score(highscore(world_api, 4))
        + "\nEEE " + pad_score(highscore(world_api, 5));
    world_api.state.set_string("highscores_text", text);
}

fn on_enter() {
    world.state.reset_scene();
    sync_highscores(world);
}

fn update(dt) {}

fn menu_label(world_api, index, label) {
    return label;
}

fn seed_highscores(world_api) {
    if world_api.session.get_int("asteroids.highscore.1") <= 0 {
        world_api.session.set_int("asteroids.highscore.1", 10000);
        world_api.session.set_int("asteroids.highscore.2", 7500);
        world_api.session.set_int("asteroids.highscore.3", 5000);
        world_api.session.set_int("asteroids.highscore.4", 2500);
        world_api.session.set_int("asteroids.highscore.5", 1000);
    }
}

fn sync_menu(world_api) {
    world_api.state.set_string("menu_start_text", menu_label(world_api, 0, "START"));
    world_api.state.set_string("menu_options_text", menu_label(world_api, 1, "OPTIONS"));
    world_api.state.set_string("menu_highscores_text", menu_label(world_api, 2, "HIGHSCORES"));
    world_api.state.set_string("menu_quit_text", menu_label(world_api, 3, "QUIT"));
}

fn on_enter() {
    world.state.reset_scene();
    world.state.set_int("menu_index", 0);
    world.state.set_string("status_text", "");
    world.state.set_string("menu_color.0", "#FFFFFFFF");
    world.state.set_string("menu_color.1", "#9A9A9AFF");
    world.state.set_string("menu_color.2", "#9A9A9AFF");
    world.state.set_string("menu_color.3", "#9A9A9AFF");
    seed_highscores(world);
    world.audio.preload("menu-move");
    world.audio.preload("menu-select");
    sync_menu(world);
}

fn update(dt) {}

fn low_mode(world_api) { world_api.session.get_bool("asteroids.low_mode") }

fn sync_options(world_api) {
    let low = "LOW: OFF";
    if low_mode(world_api) {
        low = "LOW: ON";
    }
    world_api.state.set_string("option_low_text", low);
    world_api.state.set_string("option_back_text", "BACK");
}

fn on_enter() {
    world.state.reset_scene();
    world.state.set_int("option_index", 0);
    world.state.set_string("option_color.0", "#FFFFFFFF");
    world.state.set_string("option_color.1", "#9A9A9AFF");
    world.audio.preload("menu-move");
    world.audio.preload("menu-select");
    sync_options(world);
}

fn on_event(topic, payload) {
    if topic == "asteroids.options.toggle-low" {
        world.session.set_bool("asteroids.low_mode", !low_mode(world));
        sync_options(world);
    }
}

fn update(dt) {}

import "pkg:amigo.std/input" as input;

fn root() { "playground-hud-ui-showcase.root" }
fn path(id) { root() + "." + id }
fn controls_path(id) { path("main.controls." + id) }
fn preview_path(id) { path("main.preview." + id) }
fn editor_path(id) { path("main.editor." + id) }

fn percent(value) {
    let whole = (value * 100.0).to_int();
    return whole + "%";
}

fn active_theme(world_api) { world_api.state.get_string("active_theme") }
fn volume(world_api) { world_api.state.get_float("volume") }
fn spawn_rate(world_api) { world_api.state.get_float("spawn_rate") }
fn lifetime(world_api) { world_api.state.get_float("lifetime") }
fn debug_enabled(world_api) { world_api.state.get_bool("debug_enabled") }
fn color_preset(world_api) { world_api.state.get_string("color_preset") }
fn selected_tab(world_api) { world_api.state.get_string("selected_tab") }

fn color_hex(name) {
    if name == "Blue" { return "#236DFFFF"; }
    if name == "Orange" { return "#FF8A22FF"; }
    if name == "White" { return "#F8F8F8FF"; }
    return "#7E5BFFFF";
}

fn sync_model_state(world_api) {
    world_api.state.set_string("active_theme_label", "Theme: " + active_theme(world_api));
    world_api.state.set_string("volume_label", "Volume " + percent(volume(world_api)));
    world_api.state.set_string("debug_label", if debug_enabled(world_api) { "Debug overlay ON" } else { "Debug overlay OFF" });
    world_api.state.set_string("selected_tab_label", "Active tab: " + selected_tab(world_api));
    world_api.state.set_string("spawn_rate_label", "Spawn rate " + percent(spawn_rate(world_api)));
    world_api.state.set_string("lifetime_label", "Lifetime " + percent(lifetime(world_api)));
    world_api.state.set_string("color_preset_label", "Color preset " + color_preset(world_api));
    world_api.state.set_string("color_swatch", color_hex(color_preset(world_api)));
    world_api.state.set_string("debug_text", "selected_theme=" + active_theme(world_api) + " selected_tab=" + selected_tab(world_api) + " volume=" + percent(volume(world_api)) + " spawn_rate=" + percent(spawn_rate(world_api)));
}

fn set_theme(world_api, theme) {
    world_api.state.set_string("active_theme", theme);
    world_api.ui.set_text(path("toast.message"), "Theme changed: " + theme);
    world_api.ui.show(path("toast"));
    sync_model_state(world_api);
}

fn clamp01(value) {
    if value < 0.0 { return 0.0; }
    if value > 1.0 { return 1.0; }
    return value;
}

fn on_enter() {
    world.state.reset_scene();
    world.state.set_string("active_theme", "space_dark");
    world.state.set_float("volume", 0.65);
    world.state.set_float("spawn_rate", 0.72);
    world.state.set_float("lifetime", 0.42);
    world.state.set_bool("debug_enabled", true);
    world.state.set_string("color_preset", "Blue");
    world.state.set_string("selected_tab", "Color");
    sync_model_state(world);
}

fn update(dt) {
    if input::pressed(world, "ui.theme.space_dark") {
        set_theme(world, "space_dark");
    }
    if input::pressed(world, "ui.theme.clean_dev") {
        set_theme(world, "clean_dev");
    }
    if input::pressed(world, "ui.theme.cycle") {
        if active_theme(world) == "space_dark" {
            set_theme(world, "clean_dev");
        } else {
            set_theme(world, "space_dark");
        }
    }
}

fn on_event(topic, payload) {
    if topic == "playground-hud-ui.theme.space-dark" {
        set_theme(world, "space_dark");
        return;
    }
    if topic == "playground-hud-ui.theme.clean-dev" {
        set_theme(world, "clean_dev");
        return;
    }
    if topic == "playground-hud-ui.volume.changed" {
        world.state.set_float("volume", payload[0].to_float());
        sync_model_state(world);
        return;
    }
    if topic == "playground-hud-ui.debug.changed" {
        world.state.set_bool("debug_enabled", payload[0].to_float() >= 0.5);
        sync_model_state(world);
        return;
    }
    if topic == "playground-hud-ui.spawn-rate.changed" {
        world.state.set_float("spawn_rate", payload[0].to_float());
        sync_model_state(world);
        return;
    }
    if topic == "playground-hud-ui.lifetime.changed" {
        world.state.set_float("lifetime", payload[0].to_float());
        sync_model_state(world);
        return;
    }
    if topic == "playground-hud-ui.color.changed" {
        world.state.set_string("color_preset", payload[0]);
        sync_model_state(world);
        return;
    }
    if topic == "playground-hud-ui.tab.changed" {
        world.state.set_string("selected_tab", payload[0]);
        sync_model_state(world);
        return;
    }
    if topic == "playground-hud-ui.stepper.minus" {
        world.state.set_float("volume", clamp01(volume(world) - 0.05));
        sync_model_state(world);
        return;
    }
    if topic == "playground-hud-ui.stepper.plus" {
        world.state.set_float("volume", clamp01(volume(world) + 0.05));
        sync_model_state(world);
        return;
    }
}

# Camera Film Profiles

Film profiles describe both tone response and scan/grain behavior for `Camera2D`.

Attach a profile from a scene camera:

```yaml
film:
  profile: rotten-club/camera/film/polish-night-custom
  intensity: 0.65
  seed: 1986
```

## Grain Model

`grain` is not a flat noise overlay. It is evaluated per frame in `ScanOutput`
and responds to image density:

- `shadow_amount` - grain contribution in dark density regions, usually `0.0..1.0`.
- `midtone_amount` - grain contribution around the usable straight-line region, usually `0.0..1.0`.
- `highlight_amount` - remaining grain in bright regions, usually lower than midtones.
- `highlight_suppression` - how strongly highlights clean up, `0.0..1.0`.
- `fine_grain_px`, `medium_grain_px`, `coarse_grain_px` - spatial grain scales in output pixels.
- `clumpiness` - blends medium grain toward coarse clustered grain, `0.0..1.0`.
- `softness` - blends sharp pixel grain toward softer dye-cloud grain, `0.0..1.0`.
- `luma_amount` - density/luma grain strength.
- `chroma_amount` - color dye-cloud grain strength.
- `regenerate_per_frame` - when `true`, the grain pattern is resampled every frame.
- `underexposure_boost` - extra grain in underexposed shadows.
- `push_process_boost` - extra roughness for pushed high-speed looks.
- `channel_r`, `channel_g`, `channel_b` - color layer balance.
- `temporal_jitter` - when `regenerate_per_frame` is `true`, `1.0` fully resamples each frame; lower values retain more static scan texture.

Keep grain shape and color noise inside the `grain:` block. Film YAML should not
define top-level `grain_size` or `chroma_noise`.

Recommended models:

- `clean_digital` - nearly neutral scan.
- `modern_color_negative` - Vision/Portra-like controlled color negative grain.
- `fast_color_negative` - ISO 800/1600 color negative with visible shadow grain.
- `bw_silver_pushed` - pushed black-and-white silver grain, high clumpiness.
- `fine_reversal` - fine slide/reversal grain with clean highlights.
- `dirty_scan` - expired/cheap lab scan with stronger chroma and coarse structure.

# Rotten Club Camera Look Profiles

These files define camera-owned final look presets.
They are reusable mod assets, not scene-local post-fx blobs.

## Where to put them

Use:
- `mods/rotten-club/camera/look/*.yml`

Recommended preset in this mod:
- `rotten-club/camera/look/rotten-noir-print`

## How to attach to Camera2D

Add this to a `Camera2D` component:

```yaml
look:
  profile: rotten-club/camera/look/rotten-noir-print
  intensity: 0.85
```

Runtime ownership stays on `Camera2D`.
Authoring storage stays in the mod asset.

## YAML shape

```yaml
kind: camera-look-profile-2d
label: Rotten Noir Print
id: rotten_noir_print
palette_size: 28
dither_strength: 0.10
dither_scale: 1.0
layered_dither: 0.18
opacity: 0.82
luma_preserve: 0.60
highlight_bias: 0.08
shadow_bias: -0.10
contrast: 1.12
saturation: 0.84
gamma: 0.96
seed: 1986
```

## Property guide

- `palette_size`: usually `12..64`. Lower values push a harsher print-style palette.
- `dither_strength`: usually `0.0..0.3`. Higher values add more visible grainy breakup.
- `dither_scale`: usually `0.5..2.0`. Changes dither cell scale.
- `layered_dither`: usually `0.0..0.5`. Adds a second layer of texture.
- `opacity`: usually `0.0..1.0`. Base effect opacity before `Camera2D.look.intensity`.
- `luma_preserve`: usually `0.0..1.0`. Higher values preserve original luminance more closely.
- `highlight_bias`: usually `-0.3..0.3`. Positive values brighten highlights.
- `shadow_bias`: usually `-0.3..0.3`. Negative values deepen shadows.
- `contrast`: usually `0.6..1.4`.
- `saturation`: usually `0.0..1.4`.
- `gamma`: usually `0.7..1.3`.
- `seed`: integer. Changes dither pattern.

# Rotten Club Rain Glass Profiles

These files define camera-owned rain-on-lens presets.
They are mod assets, not hardcoded runtime tweaks.

## Where to put them

Use:
- `mods/rotten-club/camera/rain/*.yml`

Recommended presets in this mod:
- `rotten-club/camera/rain/realistic-lens-rain`
- `rotten-club/camera/rain/heavy-condensation`
- `rotten-club/camera/rain/thin-neon-drizzle`

## How to attach to Camera2D

Add this to a `Camera2D` component:

```yaml
lens_surface:
  rain_profile: rotten-club/camera/rain/realistic-lens-rain
```

Runtime ownership stays on `Camera2D`.
Authoring storage stays in the mod asset.

## Runtime control

Lens rain is owned by `Camera2D`, not by scene/global post-fx.

Use this from Rhai:

```rhai
world.camera.set_main_lens_rain("spawn_rate=6 opacity=0.6 mist_opacity=0.04");
world.camera.set_lens_rain("main", "preset=thin");
world.camera.clear_main_lens_rain_override();
```

Do not use this for camera lens rain:

```rhai
world.postfx.set_rain_glass(...)
```

That API is old/debug-only and targets global frame post-fx.

## Property guide

### `spawn`
- `enabled`: `true|false`. Master switch.
- `spawn_rate`: `0.0..20.0`. Higher = more new droplets per second.
- `spawn_limit`: `0..2000`. Hard cap for active droplets.
- `seed`: integer. Changes pattern repeat.

### `droplets`
- `min_radius_px`, `max_radius_px`: usually `18..120`.
  Lower than `2.0` for micro-sized droplets is a bad idea. Tiny values collapse into ugly pixel specks.
- `gravity_px_per_sec2`: usually `1200..3200`.
  Higher = faster downward travel.
- `slip_rate`: usually `0.1..0.6`.
  Higher = droplets break loose more easily.
- `initial_spread`: usually `0.2..0.7`.
  Higher = fatter wet bodies.
- `shrink_rate`: usually `0.005..0.03`.
  Higher = droplets thin out faster.
- `evaporate`: usually `4.0..16.0`.
  Higher = shorter life.
- `velocity_spread`: usually `0.1..0.5`.
  Higher = more irregular motion.
- `motion_interval_min`, `motion_interval_max`: usually `0.1..1.5`.
  Controls cadence of droplet updates.
- `x_shift_min`, `x_shift_max`: usually `-20..20`.
  Small lateral drift. Too large looks fake.
- `collider_scale`: usually `0.7..1.2`.
  Affects collision / merge feel.

### `trails`
- `enabled`: enables streak children behind main drops.
- `trail_drop_density`: usually `0.1..0.6`.
- `trail_drop_size_min`, `trail_drop_size_max`: usually `2..20`.
- `trail_distance_min_px`, `trail_distance_max_px`: usually `4..80`.
- `trail_spread`: usually `0.1..0.5`.
- `trail_shrink_rate`: usually `0.005..0.03`.
- `trail_evaporate`: usually `3.0..12.0`.
- `trail_taper`: usually `0.4..0.9`.
- `trail_refract_scale`: usually `0.2..1.0`.
- `trail_opacity`: usually `0.1..0.7`.
- `streak_boost`: usually `0.0..0.6`.
- `streak_length`: usually `0.0..1.0`.

### `micro_droplets`
- `enabled`: enables fine peppering.
- `micro_droplets_per_second`: usually `0..140`.
- `micro_droplet_min_px`, `micro_droplet_max_px`: usually `2.0..8.0`.
  Keep the minimum above roughly `2.0` for this mod if you want to avoid single-pixel junk.

### `mist`
- `enabled`: condensation veil.
- `mist_opacity`: usually `0.0..0.18`.
  Above `0.20` the image gets milky fast.
- `mist_blur_px`: usually `0.0..6.0`.
- `mist_accumulation`: usually `0.0..0.08`.
- `mist_time`: usually `0.0..1.5`.
- `mist_color_strength`: usually `0.0..0.2`.
- `mist_blur_step`: small integer, usually `1..3`.

### `optics`
- `refract_base`: usually `0.0..0.4`.
- `refract_scale`: usually `0.3..1.2` for realism.
  Above `1.5` gets stylized quickly.
- `distortion_px`: usually `4..24`.
- `normal_strength`: usually `1..6`.
- `chromatic_aberration`: usually `0.0..0.2`.
- `focus_blur_strength`: usually `0.0..0.4`.
- `background_blur_px`: usually `0.0..4.0`.
  Too high makes the whole frame mushy.
- `background_blur_steps`: usually `1..4`.
- `smooth_edge_min`, `smooth_edge_max`: keep inside `0.0..1.0` and keep min below max.

### `compose`
- `opacity`: overall effect visibility. Usually `0.6..1.0`.
- `body_opacity`: droplet body density. Usually `0.2..0.6`.
- `scene_blend`: usually `0.6..1.0`.
- `scene_darken`: usually `0.0..0.08`.
  If blacks go gray, this is not the first knob. Reduce mist first, then check this.
- `drop_plane_blur_px`: usually `0.0..2.0`.
- `reference_mode`: keep `true` for the more grounded look in this mod.
- `raindrop_compose`: `smoother` or `harder`.
- `raindrop_eraser_size`: usually around `0.6..1.0` on each axis.

### `lighting`
- `receives_scene_light`: should usually stay `true`.
- `scene_light_response`: usually `0.4..1.0`.
- `scene_light_tint_strength`: usually `0.0..0.5`.
- `scene_shadow_floor`: usually `0.0..0.12`.
  Higher values flatten blacks.
- `rim_strength`: usually `0.0..0.6`.
- `light_pos`: `[x, y, z, w]`. Keep near the top-half for menu rain.
- `diffuse_light`, `specular_light`: RGB triplets, usually `0.0..1.0`.
- `specular_shininess`: usually `8..64`.
- `light_bump`: usually `0.0..0.5`.

### `contamination`
- `blood_tint`: RGB triplet, normally `[0,0,0]` here.
- `blood_amount`: usually `0.0` unless intentionally stylized.

### `debug`
- `view`: `final`, `scene_input`, `blurred_scene`, `raindrop_map`, `droplet_map`, `trail_map`, `drop_normals`, `drop_mask`, `mist`, `refraction`.

## Quick tuning recipes

### Bigger droplets
- Increase `droplets.min_radius_px`
- Increase `droplets.max_radius_px`
- Lower `spawn.spawn_rate` slightly

### Stronger refraction
- Increase `optics.refract_scale`
- Increase `optics.distortion_px`
- Increase `optics.normal_strength`
- Avoid compensating with large `background_blur_px`

### Less gray milk / cleaner blacks
- Lower `mist.mist_opacity`
- Lower `mist.mist_accumulation`
- Lower `mist.mist_color_strength`
- Lower `lighting.scene_shadow_floor`
- Only then touch `compose.scene_darken`

### Longer vertical streaks
- Increase `trails.streak_length`
- Increase `trails.streak_boost`
- Increase `trails.trail_distance_max_px`

### Cleaner frame with only a few heavy drops
- Lower `spawn.spawn_rate`
- Lower `micro_droplets.micro_droplets_per_second`
- Disable `mist.enabled`
- Raise `droplets.min_radius_px`

## Preset intent

- `realistic-lens-rain.yml`
  Base preset. Balanced refractive rain for Rotten Club.
- `heavy-condensation.yml`
  Wetter, foggier, more steamed-up glass.
- `thin-neon-drizzle.yml`
  Faster, leaner streak look with less mist.

# Rotten Club Camera Profiles

Normalny workflow:
- wybierz camera preset
- koryguj `focus_distance_m`, `f_stop` i profil obiektywu
- uÅ¼ywaj `z_depth` tylko jako debug override
- local scene post-fx zostawiaj dla Å›wiadomych wyjÄ…tkÃ³w, nie jako domyÅ›lny jÄ™zyk kamery

Camera2D uses built-in engine profile IDs for now.
Camera2D can also reference YAML asset keys for custom profiles.

Recommended lens profiles:
- vintage_soviet_35mm_dirty
- gritty_club_lens
- night_bus_window
- wet_window_macro
- cheap_cctv_1996

- polish_1994_push_800

- `rotten-club/camera/film/polish-night-custom`
- `rotten-club/camera/look/rotten-noir-print`
- `rotten-club/camera/rain/realistic-lens-rain`

Rain glass / lens rain profiles live in `camera/rain/*.yml`.
Attach them from `Camera2D` with:

```yaml
lens_surface:
  rain_profile: rotten-club/camera/rain/realistic-lens-rain
```

Camera lens-surface effects are camera-owned. Runtime animation should go through
`world.camera.*`, not `world.postfx.*`.

Look profiles live in `camera/look/*.yml`.
Attach them from `Camera2D` with:

```yaml
look:
  profile: rotten-club/camera/look/rotten-noir-print
  intensity: 0.85
```

Film profiles live in `camera/film/*.yml`. Their `grain` section controls the
camera-owned scan grain model: density response, chroma/luma grain balance,
grain scale, clumpiness, highlight cleanup and per-frame sampling.

# Main Menu Scene Layout

- `camera/` - the scene camera entity plus scene-local motion and DOF control state.
- `render/` - render layers and frame ordering.
- `world/` - background and static scene objects.
- `lighting/` - global lights, beacons, and light routing.
- `weather/` - world-space rain particles.
- `interaction/` - local control entity, action map, and menu event pipelines.
- `ui/` - mounted UI fragments for the scene.
- `input/` - input actions used by the scene.
- `events/` - scene event pipelines.
- `state/` - initial scene state.

Camera profiles remain mod-level reusable assets in `mods/rotten-club/camera/*`.
Scene-local camera entities only reference those assets.
Camera motion lives beside the scene camera in `camera/motion.yml`; Rhai only executes the authored values.
Camera DOF keyboard controls live in `camera/dof-controls.yml`: `[` / `]` focal length, `;` / `'` f-stop, `.` / `/` focus depth.

import "mod:fx/ids" as ids;
import "mod:fx/camera_dof_controls" as camera_dof;
import "mod:fx/camera_presets" as camera_presets;
import "mod:fx/main_menu_intro" as intro;
import "mod:fx/menu_state" as menu_state;
import "mod:fx/rain" as rain;

fn clamp01(value) {
    if value < 0.0 {
        return 0.0;
    }
    if value > 1.0 {
        return 1.0;
    }
    value
}

fn clamp(value, min_value, max_value) {
    if value < min_value {
        return min_value;
    }
    if value > max_value {
        return max_value;
    }
    value
}

fn prompt_color(alpha) {
    let a = clamp01(alpha);
    if a < 0.03125 { return "#7D879600"; }
    if a < 0.09375 { return "#7D879610"; }
    if a < 0.15625 { return "#7D879620"; }
    if a < 0.21875 { return "#7D879630"; }
    if a < 0.28125 { return "#7D879640"; }
    if a < 0.34375 { return "#7D879650"; }
    if a < 0.40625 { return "#7D879660"; }
    if a < 0.46875 { return "#7D879670"; }
    if a < 0.53125 { return "#7D879680"; }
    if a < 0.59375 { return "#7D879690"; }
    if a < 0.65625 { return "#7D8796A0"; }
    if a < 0.71875 { return "#7D8796B0"; }
    if a < 0.78125 { return "#7D8796C0"; }
    if a < 0.84375 { return "#7D8796D0"; }
    if a < 0.90625 { return "#7D8796E0"; }
    if a < 0.96875 { return "#7D8796F0"; }
    "#7D8796FF"
}

fn update_camera_sway(world_api, time) {
    if !world_api.state.get_bool("camera_motion.enabled") {
        return;
    }

    let intro_breath_t = clamp01(time / 6.0);
    let dolly_signal = (time * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.dolly.frequency")).sin();
    let zoom_breath_amount = world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.dolly.zoom_intro_amount")
        + (world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.dolly.zoom_final_amount")
            - world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.dolly.zoom_intro_amount"))
            * intro_breath_t;
    let zoom_breath = dolly_signal * zoom_breath_amount;
    let camera_scale = 1.05 * (1.0 + zoom_breath);
    let camera_z_m = dolly_signal * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.dolly.amplitude_m");
    world_api.camera.set_main_dolly_signal(dolly_signal);
    world_api.camera.set_main_camera_z_m(camera_z_m);
    world_api.camera.set_main_sway_amounts(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, zoom_breath_amount, 0.0);
    let x = (time * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.sway.x.primary_frequency")).sin()
            * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.sway.x.primary_amplitude")
        + (time * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.sway.x.secondary_frequency")).sin()
            * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.sway.x.secondary_amplitude")
        + (time * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.sway.x.detail_frequency")).sin()
            * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.sway.x.detail_amplitude");
    let y = (time * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.sway.y.primary_frequency")).cos()
            * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.sway.y.primary_amplitude")
        + (time * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.sway.y.secondary_frequency")).sin()
            * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.sway.y.secondary_amplitude")
        + (time * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.sway.y.detail_frequency")).cos()
            * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.sway.y.detail_amplitude");
    let rotation = (time * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.rotation.primary_frequency")).sin()
            * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.rotation.primary_amplitude")
        + (time * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.rotation.secondary_frequency")).sin()
            * world_api.state.get_float("camera_motion.rotation.secondary_amplitude");
    world_api.entities.set_position_2d(ids::camera_entity(), x, y);
    world_api.entities.set_rotation_2d(ids::camera_entity(), rotation);
    world_api.entities.set_scale_2d(ids::camera_entity(), camera_scale, camera_scale);
}

fn on_enter() {
    world.state.reset_scene();

    menu_state::seed(world);
    camera_presets::apply(world);
    camera_dof::apply(world);
    rain::reset(world);
    intro::reset(world);

    world.entities.hide(ids::menu_entity());
    world.entities.hide(ids::press_any_key_entity());
    world.ui.hide(ids::menu_ui_root());
    world.ui.hide(ids::press_any_key_ui_root());

    world.entities.set_position_2d(ids::camera_entity(), 0.0, 0.0);
    world.entities.set_rotation_2d(ids::camera_entity(), 0.0);
    world.entities.set_scale_2d(ids::camera_entity(), 1.05, 1.05);
    world.camera.set_main_sway_frequency(0.42);
    world.camera.set_main_sway_affects_focus(false);
    world.camera.set_main_camera_z_m(0.0);
    world.camera.set_main_focus_residual_m(0.0);
    world.camera.set_main_dolly_signal(0.0);
    world.state.set_float("intro.prompt_top_space", 513.0);
    world.ui.set_color(ids::press_any_key_prompt_ui(), "#7D879600");

    world.dev.log("Rotten Club main menu loaded.");
}

fn update(dt) {
    let time = world.state.get_float("intro.t") + dt;
    world.state.set_float("intro.t", time);
    update_camera_sway(world, time);
    camera_presets::update(world);
    camera_dof::update(world, dt);

    let lights = intro::update(world, time, dt);
    rain::update(world, time, lights[0], lights[1], lights[2]);

    if intro::complete(world) && !world.state.get_bool("intro.prompt_shown") {
        world.entities.show(ids::press_any_key_entity());
        world.ui.show(ids::press_any_key_ui_root());
        world.state.set_bool("intro.prompt_shown", true);
        world.state.set_float("intro.prompt_shown_at", time);
        world.state.set_float("intro.prompt_input_after", time + 0.25);
        world.ui.set_color(ids::press_any_key_prompt_ui(), "#7D879600");
        return;
    }

    if world.state.get_bool("intro.prompt_shown") && !world.state.get_bool("intro.menu_active") {
        let shown_at = world.state.get_float("intro.prompt_shown_at");
        let fade = clamp01((time - shown_at) / 0.45);
        let prompt_top = 513.0 + (time * 1.35).sin() * 8.0;
        world.state.set_float("intro.prompt_top_space", prompt_top);
        world.ui.set_color(ids::press_any_key_prompt_ui(), prompt_color(fade));
        if time >= world.state.get_float("intro.prompt_input_after") {
            if world.actions.pressed("menu.confirm") {
                world.entities.hide(ids::press_any_key_entity());
                world.ui.hide(ids::press_any_key_ui_root());
                world.entities.show(ids::menu_entity());
                world.ui.show(ids::menu_ui_root());
                world.state.set_bool("intro.menu_active", true);
            }
        }
    }
}

fn on_event(topic, payload) {
    if !world.state.get_bool("intro.menu_active") {
        return;
    }

    if topic == "menu.start" {
        world.dev.log("Main Menu: START selected.");
        return;
    }

    if topic == "menu.options" {
        world.dev.log("Main Menu: OPTIONS selected.");
        return;
    }

    if topic == "menu.quit" {
        world.dev.log("Main Menu: QUIT selected.");
        return;
    }
}

        mode: overlay

const OFFICE_LIGHT = "office-desk-point-light";
const OFFICE_CANVAS_W = 1672.0;
const OFFICE_CANVAS_H = 941.0;
const OFFICE_BACKGROUND = "office-desk-background";
const OFFICE_BACKGROUND_LAYER = "background.room";
const OFFICE_BEACON_LAYER = "lighting.beacons";
const OFFICE_LIGHT_Z_DEFAULT = 0.49;
const OFFICE_LIGHT_Z_MIN = 0.04;
const OFFICE_LIGHT_Z_MAX = 0.96;
const OFFICE_LIGHT_Z_WHEEL_STEP = 0.006;
const OFFICE_LIGHT_Z_WHEEL_FINE_STEP = 0.0015;
const OFFICE_LIGHT_Z_KEY_SPEED = 0.18;
const OFFICE_LIGHT_XY_KEY_SPEED = 520.0;
const OFFICE_LIGHT_XY_KEY_FINE_SPEED = 130.0;
const OFFICE_LIGHT_XY_KEY_FAST_SPEED = 980.0;
const OFFICE_LIGHT_SMOOTH_HZ = 18.0;
const OFFICE_LIGHT_DEPTH_SMOOTH_HZ = 12.0;

fn on_enter() {
    world.state.set_int("office.focus_index", 2);
    world.state.set_float("office.light_intensity", 2.20);
    world.state.set_float("office.light_distance_m", 1.2);
    world.state.set_float("office.light_radius_px", 620.0);
    world.state.set_float("office.albedo_brightness", 1.0);
    world.state.set_float("office.light_target_x", 420.0);
    world.state.set_float("office.light_target_y", -35.0);
    world.state.set_float("office.light_current_x", 420.0);
    world.state.set_float("office.light_current_y", -35.0);
    world.state.set_float("office.light_target_z", 0.49);
    world.state.set_float("office.light_current_z", 0.49);
    world.state.set_int("office.light_follow_mouse", 1);
    world.state.set_int("office.relight_debug_index", 0);
    world.camera.set_main_debug_view("final_output");
    apply_focus_plane(world, 2);
    world.layered_image2d.set_base_opacity(OFFICE_BACKGROUND, 1.0);
    world.render2d.get_layer(OFFICE_BACKGROUND_LAYER).set_opacity(1.0);
    world.render2d.get_layer(OFFICE_BEACON_LAYER).set_opacity(0.0);
    world.beacon2d.set_position_2d(OFFICE_LIGHT, 420.0, -35.0);
    configure_cursor_light(world, 2.20);
    world.beacon2d.set_distance_m(OFFICE_LIGHT, 1.2);
    world.beacon2d.set_z_depth(OFFICE_LIGHT, 0.49);
    world.dev.log("Office Desk: one cursor light; left click pins/unpins follow; WASD moves pinned light; wheel changes light Z; Shift+wheel fine Z; Shift+Alt+wheel focus/blur; Ctrl+wheel intensity; Alt+wheel radius; D relight debug; R final; use plate.relight.status");
}

fn update(dt) {
    handle_cursor_light_input(world, dt);
    apply_cursor_light_smoothing(world, dt);

    if world.input.pressed("D") {
        cycle_relight_debug(world, 1);
    }

    if world.input.pressed("R") {
        set_relight_debug(world, 0);
    }

}

fn handle_cursor_light_input(world_api, dt) {
    let p = world_api.input.mouse_canvas_position(1672.0, 941.0);
    if world_api.input.mouse_pressed("left") {
        if world_api.state.get_int("office.light_follow_mouse") == 1 {
            world_api.state.set_int("office.light_follow_mouse", 0);
            if p["valid"] {
                set_light_target_xy(world_api, p["x"], p["y"]);
            }
        } else {
            world_api.state.set_int("office.light_follow_mouse", 1);
        }
    }

    if world_api.state.get_int("office.light_follow_mouse") == 1 && p["valid"] {
        set_light_target_xy(world_api, p["x"], p["y"]);
    }

    let x_axis = world_api.input.axis("D", "A");
    let y_axis = world_api.input.axis("S", "W");
    if x_axis != 0.0 || y_axis != 0.0 {
        world_api.state.set_int("office.light_follow_mouse", 0);
        let speed = light_xy_key_speed(world_api);
        let x = world_api.state.get_float("office.light_target_x") + x_axis * speed * dt;
        let y = world_api.state.get_float("office.light_target_y") + y_axis * speed * dt;
        set_light_target_xy(world_api, x, y);
    }

    let z_axis = world_api.input.axis("E,PageUp", "Q,PageDown");
    if z_axis != 0.0 {
        let speed = if world_api.input.shift_down() {
            0.18 * 0.25
        } else {
            0.18
        };
        adjust_light_z_target(world_api, z_axis * speed * dt);
    }

    let wheel = world_api.input.wheel_delta();
    if wheel != 0.0 {
        if world_api.input.shift_down() && world_api.input.alt_down() {
            adjust_focus_from_wheel(world_api, wheel);
        } else if world_api.input.ctrl_down() {
            adjust_light_intensity(world_api, wheel);
        } else if world_api.input.alt_down() {
            adjust_light_radius(world_api, wheel);
        } else if world_api.input.shift_down() {
            adjust_light_z_target(world_api, wheel * 0.0015);
        } else {
            adjust_light_z_target(world_api, wheel * 0.006);
        }
    }
}

fn adjust_focus_from_wheel(world_api, wheel) {
    if wheel > 0.0 {
        set_focus_index(world_api, world_api.state.get_int("office.focus_index") + 1);
    }
    if wheel < 0.0 {
        set_focus_index(world_api, world_api.state.get_int("office.focus_index") - 1);
    }
}

fn light_xy_key_speed(world_api) {
    if world_api.input.shift_down() {
        return 130.0;
    }
    if world_api.input.ctrl_down() {
        return 980.0;
    }
    520.0
}

fn apply_cursor_light_smoothing(world_api, dt) {
    let safe_dt = clamp_dt(dt);
    let alpha_xy = clamp_float(safe_dt * 18.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    let alpha_z = clamp_float(safe_dt * 12.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    let current_x = lerp_float(
        world_api.state.get_float("office.light_current_x"),
        world_api.state.get_float("office.light_target_x"),
        alpha_xy,
    );
    let current_y = lerp_float(
        world_api.state.get_float("office.light_current_y"),
        world_api.state.get_float("office.light_target_y"),
        alpha_xy,
    );
    let current_z = lerp_float(
        world_api.state.get_float("office.light_current_z"),
        world_api.state.get_float("office.light_target_z"),
        alpha_z,
    );
    apply_cursor_light_state(world_api, current_x, current_y, current_z);
}

fn set_light_target_xy(world_api, x, y) {
    world_api.state.set_float(
        "office.light_target_x",
        clamp_float(x, -936.0, 936.0),
    );
    world_api.state.set_float(
        "office.light_target_y",
        clamp_float(y, -570.5, 570.5),
    );
}

fn set_light_z_target(world_api, z) {
    world_api.state.set_float(
        "office.light_target_z",
        clamp_float(z, 0.04, 0.96),
    );
}

fn adjust_light_z_target(world_api, delta) {
    set_light_z_target(world_api, world_api.state.get_float("office.light_target_z") + delta);
}

fn apply_cursor_light_state(world_api, x, y, z) {
    world_api.state.set_float("office.light_current_x", x);
    world_api.state.set_float("office.light_current_y", y);
    world_api.state.set_float("office.light_current_z", z);
    world_api.beacon2d.set_position_2d("office-desk-point-light", x, y);
    world_api.beacon2d.set_z_depth("office-desk-point-light", z);
}

fn on_event(topic, payload) {
}

fn set_focus_index(world_api, index) {
    let clamped = clamp_focus_index(index);
    world_api.state.set_int("office.focus_index", clamped);
    apply_focus_plane(world_api, clamped);
}

fn clamp_focus_index(index) {
    if index < 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    if index > 7 {
        return 7;
    }
    index
}

fn apply_focus_plane(world_api, index) {
    world_api.camera.set_main_focus_distance_m(focus_distance_for_index(index));
}

fn cycle_relight_debug(world_api, delta) {
    let current = world_api.state.get_int("office.relight_debug_index");
    let next = current + delta;
    if next > 18 {
        set_relight_debug(world_api, 0);
    } else {
        set_relight_debug(world_api, next);
    }
}

fn set_relight_debug(world_api, index) {
    let clamped = clamp_debug_index(index);
    let view = relight_debug_view_for_index(clamped);
    world_api.state.set_int("office.relight_debug_index", clamped);
    world_api.camera.set_main_debug_view(view);
    world_api.dev.log("Office Desk relight debug: " + view);
}

fn clamp_debug_index(index) {
    if index < 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    if index > 18 {
        return 18;
    }
    index
}

    if index <= 0 {
        return "final_output";
    }

    }
    if index == 7 {
        return "plate_relight_surface_glass";
    }
    if index == 8 {
        return "plate_relight_surface_mask";
    }
    if index == 9 {
        return "plate_relight_effective_depth";
    }
    if index == 10 {
        return "plate_relight_normal";

    if index == 11 {

fn adjust_light_intensity(world_api, wheel) {
    let next = clamp_float(
        world_api.state.get_float("office.light_intensity") + wheel * 0.04,
        0.05,
        6.0,
    );
    world_api.state.set_float("office.light_intensity", next);
    world_api.beacon2d.set_base_intensity("office-desk-point-light", next);
    world_api.beacon2d.set_glow_strength("office-desk-point-light", 0.0);
    world_api.beacon2d.set_bloom("office-desk-point-light", 0.0);
}

fn adjust_light_radius(world_api, wheel) {
    let next = clamp_float(
        world_api.state.get_float("office.light_radius_px") + wheel * 12.0,
        120.0,
        1100.0,
    );
    world_api.state.set_float("office.light_radius_px", next);
    world_api.beacon2d.set_halo_radius_px("office-desk-point-light", next);
}

fn adjust_albedo_brightness(world_api, wheel) {
    let next = clamp_float(
        world_api.state.get_float("office.albedo_brightness") + wheel * 0.04,
        0.25,
        1.0,
    );
    world_api.state.set_float("office.albedo_brightness", next);
    world_api.layered_image2d.set_base_opacity("office-desk-background", next);
    world_api.render2d.get_layer("background.room").set_opacity(next);
}

fn configure_cursor_light(world_api, intensity) {
    world_api.beacon2d.set_base_intensity("office-desk-point-light", intensity);
    world_api.beacon2d.set_core_radius_px("office-desk-point-light", 18.0);
    world_api.beacon2d.set_halo_radius_px("office-desk-point-light", 620.0);
    world_api.state.set_float("office.light_radius_px", 620.0);
    world_api.beacon2d.set_glow_strength("office-desk-point-light", 0.0);
    world_api.beacon2d.set_bloom("office-desk-point-light", 0.0);
}

fn clamp_float(value, min_value, max_value) {
    if value < min_value {
        return min_value;
    }
    if value > max_value {
        return max_value;
    }
    value
}

fn clamp_dt(dt) {
    clamp_float(dt, 0.0, 0.05)
}

fn lerp_float(a, b, t) {
    a + (b - a) * clamp_float(t, 0.0, 1.0)
}

fn focus_distance_for_index(index) {
    if index <= 0 {
        return 0.5;
    }
    if index == 1 {
        return 0.8;
    }
    if index == 2 {
        return 1.2;
    }
    if index == 3 {
        return 2.0;
    }
    if index == 4 {
        return 3.5;
    }
    if index == 5 {
        return 6.0;
    }
    if index == 6 {
        return 12.0;
    }
    24.0
}

fn clamp(value, min_value, max_value) {
    if value < min_value {
        return min_value;
    }
    if value > max_value {
        return max_value;
    }
    value
}

fn axis_delta(axis, step) {
    if axis > 0 {
        return step;
    }
    if axis < 0 {
        return -step;
    }
    0.0
}

fn apply(world_api) {
    let focal = clamp(world_api.state.get_float("camera_dof_controls.focal_length_mm"), 8.0, 300.0);
    let f_stop = clamp(world_api.state.get_float("camera_dof_controls.aperture_f_stop"), 0.7, 32.0);

    world_api.state.set_float("camera_dof_controls.focal_length_mm", focal);
    world_api.state.set_float("camera_dof_controls.aperture_f_stop", f_stop);

    world_api.camera.set_main_focal_length_mm(focal);
    world_api.camera.set_main_aperture_f_stop(f_stop);
    if world_api.state.get_bool("camera_dof_controls.manual_focus_enabled") {
        let focus = clamp(world_api.state.get_float("camera_dof_controls.focus_distance_m"), 0.2, 1000.0);
        world_api.state.set_float("camera_dof_controls.focus_distance_m", focus);
        world_api.camera.set_main_focus_distance_m(focus);
    }
}

fn update(world_api, dt) {
    if !world_api.state.get_bool("camera_dof_controls.enabled") {
        return;
    }

    let focal_axis = world_api.input.axis("]", "[");
    let aperture_axis = world_api.input.axis("'", ";");
    let focus_axis = world_api.input.axis("/", ".");
    let changed = focal_axis != 0 || aperture_axis != 0 || focus_axis != 0;

    if focus_axis != 0 {
        world_api.state.set_bool("camera_dof_controls.manual_focus_enabled", true);
    }

    if !changed {
        return;
    }

    let focal_delta = axis_delta(
        focal_axis,
        world_api.state.get_float("camera_dof_controls.focal_length_speed_mm_per_second") * dt,
    );
    let aperture_delta = axis_delta(
        aperture_axis,
        world_api.state.get_float("camera_dof_controls.aperture_speed_f_stop_per_second") * dt,
    );
    let focus_delta = axis_delta(
        focus_axis,
        world_api.state.get_float("camera_dof_controls.focus_distance_speed_m_per_second") * dt,
    );

    world_api.state.set_float(
        "camera_dof_controls.focal_length_mm",
        world_api.state.get_float("camera_dof_controls.focal_length_mm") + focal_delta,
    );
    world_api.state.set_float(
        "camera_dof_controls.aperture_f_stop",
        world_api.state.get_float("camera_dof_controls.aperture_f_stop") + aperture_delta,
    );
    world_api.state.set_float(
        "camera_dof_controls.focus_distance_m",
        world_api.state.get_float("camera_dof_controls.focus_distance_m") + focus_delta,
    );

    apply(world_api);
}

fn clamp(value, min_value, max_value) {
    if value < min_value {
        return min_value;
    }
    if value > max_value {
        return max_value;
    }
    value
}

fn slot_key(slot, suffix) {
    "camera_presets.slot_" + slot + "." + suffix
}

fn apply_slot(world_api, slot) {
    let preset_id = world_api.state.get_string(slot_key(slot, "preset_id"));
    if preset_id == "" {
        return false;
    }

    let label = world_api.state.get_string(slot_key(slot, "label"));
    let focal = clamp(world_api.state.get_float(slot_key(slot, "focal_length_mm")), 8.0, 300.0);
    let f_stop = clamp(world_api.state.get_float(slot_key(slot, "aperture_f_stop")), 0.7, 32.0);
    let focus = clamp(world_api.state.get_float(slot_key(slot, "focus_distance_m")), 0.2, 1000.0);
    let shutter_enabled = world_api.state.get_bool(slot_key(slot, "shutter_enabled"));
    let shutter_speed_s = clamp(world_api.state.get_float(slot_key(slot, "shutter_speed_s")), 1.0 / 8000.0, 2.0);
    let shutter_opacity = clamp(world_api.state.get_float(slot_key(slot, "shutter_opacity")), 0.0, 1.0);

    if !world_api.camera.set_main_preset(preset_id) {
        return false;
    }

    world_api.state.set_string("camera_presets.active_slot", slot);
    world_api.state.set_string("camera_presets.active_label", label);
    world_api.state.set_string("camera_presets.active_preset_id", preset_id);
    world_api.state.set_float("camera_dof_controls.focal_length_mm", focal);
    world_api.state.set_float("camera_dof_controls.aperture_f_stop", f_stop);
    world_api.state.set_float("camera_dof_controls.focus_distance_m", focus);

    world_api.camera.set_main_focal_length_mm(focal);
    world_api.camera.set_main_aperture_f_stop(f_stop);
    world_api.camera.set_main_focus_distance_m(focus);
    world_api.camera.set_main_shutter_enabled(shutter_enabled);
    world_api.camera.set_main_shutter_speed_s(shutter_speed_s);
    world_api.camera.set_main_shutter_opacity(shutter_opacity);
    world_api.dev.log("Camera preset [" + slot + "] " + label + " -> " + preset_id);
    true
}

fn apply(world_api) {
    if !world_api.state.get_bool("camera_presets.enabled") {
        return;
    }

    let active_slot = world_api.state.get_string("camera_presets.active_slot");
    if active_slot == "" {
        apply_slot(world_api, "1");
        return;
    }

    apply_slot(world_api, active_slot);
}

fn update(world_api) {
    if !world_api.state.get_bool("camera_presets.enabled") {
        return;
    }

    if world_api.actions.pressed("camera.preset.1") {
        apply_slot(world_api, "1");
        return;
    }
    if world_api.actions.pressed("camera.preset.2") {
        apply_slot(world_api, "2");
        return;
    }
    if world_api.actions.pressed("camera.preset.3") {
        apply_slot(world_api, "3");
        return;
    }
    if world_api.actions.pressed("camera.preset.4") {
        apply_slot(world_api, "4");
        return;
    }
    if world_api.actions.pressed("camera.preset.5") {
        apply_slot(world_api, "5");
        return;
    }
    if world_api.actions.pressed("camera.preset.6") {
        apply_slot(world_api, "6");
        return;
    }
    if world_api.actions.pressed("camera.preset.7") {
        apply_slot(world_api, "7");
        return;
    }
    if world_api.actions.pressed("camera.preset.8") {
        apply_slot(world_api, "8");
        return;
    }
    if world_api.actions.pressed("camera.preset.9") {
        apply_slot(world_api, "9");
        return;
    }
    if world_api.actions.pressed("camera.preset.0") {
        apply_slot(world_api, "0");
    }
}

import "mod:fx/ids" as ids;
import "mod:fx/sequence" as seq;

fn final_title_visibility() {
    1.0
}

fn reset(world_api) {
    let background = ids::background_entity();
    let lightning = world_api.light2d.get_group(ids::lightning_id());

    world_api.state.set_float("intro.t", 0.0);
    world_api.state.set_bool("intro.focus.skyline_started", false);
    world_api.state.set_bool("intro.focus.far_street_started", false);
    world_api.state.set_bool("intro.focus.club_started", false);
    world_api.state.set_bool("intro.focus.title_started", false);
    world_api.state.set_bool("intro.focus_hunt.near_started", false);
    world_api.state.set_bool("intro.focus_hunt.far_started", false);
    world_api.state.set_bool("intro.focus_hunt.locked", false);
    world_api.state.set_bool("intro.bar_lit", false);
    world_api.state.set_bool("intro.club_lit", false);
    world_api.state.set_bool("intro.pharmacy_lit", false);
    world_api.state.set_bool("intro.rain_started", false);
    world_api.state.set_bool("intro.lightning_fired", false);
    world_api.state.set_bool("intro.title_reveal_started", false);
    world_api.state.set_bool("intro.title_shown", false);
    world_api.state.set_bool("intro.complete", false);
    world_api.state.set_float("intro.title_alpha", 0.0);
    world_api.state.set_float("intro.rain_intensity", 0.0);
    world_api.state.set_float("intro.lightning_intensity", 0.0);
    world_api.state.set_float("bar.next_flicker", 0.0);
    world_api.state.set_float("bar.mul", 1.0);
    world_api.state.set_float("club.next_flicker", 0.0);
    world_api.state.set_float("club.mul", 1.0);
    world_api.state.set_float("skyline.next_flicker", 0.0);
    world_api.state.set_float("skyline.mul", 1.0);
    world_api.state.set_float("pharmacy.next_fault", 12.0);
    world_api.state.set_float("pharmacy.mul", 0.0);

    world_api.entities.hide(ids::title_entity());
    world_api.render2d.get_layer(ids::title_layer()).set_opacity(0.0);

    world_api.layered_image2d.set_base_opacity(background, 0.0);
    world_api.layered_image2d.set_opacity(background, "skyline", 0.0);
    world_api.layered_image2d.set_opacity(background, "club_sign", 0.0);
    world_api.layered_image2d.set_opacity(background, "club_entry", 0.0);
    world_api.layered_image2d.set_opacity(background, "bar_sign", 0.0);
    world_api.layered_image2d.set_opacity(background, "bar_lanterns", 0.0);
    world_api.layered_image2d.set_opacity(background, "pharmacy_cross", 0.0);
    world_api.layered_image2d.set_opacity(background, "rain_relief_edges", 0.0);

    world_api.light2d.get_light("beacon-red").set_intensity(0.0);
